question_sentence: Who is set to leave her role as White House press secretary at the end of August?
evidence: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt will leave her role at the end of the month, President Donald Trump announced Wednesday. The imminent departure of one of the president’s closest allies inside the White House marks a major shakeup for the administration’s press operation, with less than three months until the midterm elections.

question_sentence: In which state was the winning ticket for the $1.04 billion Powerball jackpot sold this week?
evidence: A winning ticket for Wednesday night’s $1.04 billion Powerball drawing was sold at a Hy-Vee gas station in Quincy, Illinois. It was the first billion-dollar Powerball jackpot since a player in Arkansas took home $1.8 billion on Christmas Eve last year.

question_sentence: Part of which national park is being cleared for construction of President Trump’s border wall project?
